contributions.statement: MicroVM delta checkpoint/restore can make sandbox state management ~1-2% of agent wall time (10.8 ms checkpoint, 1.9 ms restore) versus 23-48% for diff-based snapshots, which matters only for tree-search or RL fan-out.
contributions.evidence: §6.2.1 Table 2, Fig. 6: replayed SWE-bench MCTS trajectories; agent-level benefit not measured; Python-only, no JVM processes.
relative_to: container snapshots / git worktrees for agent rollback

reason: Credible sandbox latency engineering for MCTS and RL rollout fan-out. A human-paced Java team running interactive agents does not have that workload, and JVM checkpointing is untested.
